description: This file defines the InvestOrigin class within the Goteo\Entity\Invest namespace, representing an investment origin entity with properties such as invest ID, source, detail, and allocated amount. It includes getter and setter methods for these properties and a method to fetch the related Invest object.

classes.name: InvestOrigin
classes.description: A class representing the origin details of an investment, including properties like source, detail, and related investment ID.

methods.name: getInvestId
methods.description: Returns the investment ID associated with this origin.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Fetches the Invest object associated with this origin using the investment ID.

methods.name: setInvestId
methods.description: Sets the investment ID for this origin.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source of the investment.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source of the investment.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns additional details about the investment origin.

methods.name: setDetail
methods.description: Sets additional details about the investment origin.

methods.name: getAllocated
methods.description: Returns the allocated amount or description, if any.

methods.name: setAllocated
methods.description: Sets the allocated amount or description.
